description: This file contains functions and types related to authorizing and managing access control for Mattermost channels and commands, including normalization of entries, permission checks, and decision logic.

methods.name: normalizeMattermostAllowEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a Mattermost allow entry string by trimming, removing specific prefixes, and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeMattermostAllowList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of entries into a set of unique, lowercase, trimmed strings.

methods.name: resolveMattermostEffectiveAllowFromLists
methods.description: Resolves effective allow lists based on input lists and policies.

methods.name: isMattermostSenderAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a sender is allowed based on the normalized allow list.

methods.name: authorizeMattermostCommandInvocation
methods.description: Determines if a command invocation in Mattermost is authorized based on channel info, sender, and configuration.
